mapper.insert: INSERT INTO orders (userId, orderName, orderDate, orderAddress, orderTel) VALUES (#{userId}, #{orderName}, #{orderDate}, #{orderAddress}, #{orderTel})

INSERT INTO order_items (orderId, itemId, quantity, price, username) VALUES
(#{it.orderId}, #{it.itemId}, #{it.quantity}, #{it.price}, #{it.username})
mapper.select: SELECT orderId, userId, orderName, orderDate, orderAddress, orderTel FROM orders WHERE orderId = #{orderId}
SELECT orderId, userId, orderName, orderDate, orderAddress, orderTel FROM orders WHERE userId = #{userId} ORDER BY orderDate DESC, orderId DESC
SELECT orderId, itemId, quantity, price, username FROM order_items WHERE orderId = #{orderId} ORDER BY itemId

SELECT oi.itemId AS itemId, COALESCE( NULLIF(i.attr3, ''), CONCAT(IFNULL(p.name, ''), IFNULL(CONCAT(' / ', NULLIF(i.attr1, '')), '')), oi.itemId ) AS itemName, oi.quantity AS quantity, oi.price AS price FROM order_items oi LEFT JOIN item i ON i.itemid = oi.itemId LEFT JOIN product p ON p.productid = i.productid WHERE oi.orderId = #{orderId} ORDER BY oi.itemId
SELECT orderId, itemId, quantity, price, username FROM order_items WHERE orderId IN #{id} ORDER BY orderId, itemId
